properties.displayName: SCF - Manual attestation for usage of Data Management tool for data discovery and classification
properties.description: This policy requires manual attestation to confirm that an accurate inventory of data flows is maintained, sensitive data is classified, and storage/processing jurisdictions are identified using the approved Data Management tool. Bank-approved masking techniques are applied to cloud workloads based on sensitivity and regulatory classification, integrated into CI/CD pipelines, with rules reviewed periodically or upon classification changes.
